description: open-the-day in a workspace as `chief-of-stuff init` leaves it: a `Settings:` line and no `Health:` line. The settings file has `[workers] mode = "oneshot"`, which the schema refuses (it is `one-shot`). #47's acceptance: "A red eval case with an invalid `[workers] mode`: `health` names the key and exits nonzero." So opening the day runs `health`, which loads the file, and the reply names the setting. The `health was run` grader reads the call's `command`, not its description. Not covered: a command that names the phrase without running it (`chief-of-stuff health --help`, a grep or an echo of `chief-of-stuff health`).
